children: Binance Wallet announced on X that its wallet services are not supervised by a regulatory authority. The notice says users are solely responsible for their access to or use of decentralized applications, or dApps, through Binance Wallet. It also states that users should conduct their own research before using Binance Wallet and that the information provided is not financial advice. The announcement directs users to review the Terms of Use and Risk Warning.

title: Binance Wallet States Users Are Responsible for Their Own Use of dApps
